acquisition.location: The Isle of Armor — Tower of Darkness
acquisition.method: After defeating Mustard at the top of the tower, have Kubfu inspect the scroll to evolve. In these games the scroll is an interactive object and is not added to the Bag.
requirements: Choose and complete the Tower of Darkness

acquisition.method: Purchase the Scroll of Darkness when it appears after the game detects that the player owns a Kubfu.
